caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object centered on a plain, light-colored background. The object appears to be a pendant or decorative plaque, rendered in shades of gray, with intricate, symmetrical openwork details. The upper part features interwoven looping shapes, almost forming a lattice or knot-like design, framed by two rounded projections with leaf-like motifs. The lower portion consists of a slightly convex surface that displays what appears to be a relief image, possibly including human or animal figures, though the details are not sharply defined. The whole object has a roughly teardrop outline, with a rounded, almost shield-like body and a narrow, pointed end at the bottom. The artist's signature, "J. Staloff," is written in small letters at the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Match Safe
